item.text: The failure has two direct causes: JavaScript months are zero-based, but the formatter emits `getUTCMonth()` unchanged; and the exported title still uses the old text. I’m correcting both at their source.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc 'npm test && git diff --check && git diff -- lib/dates.js reports/summary.js'
/bin/zsh -lc 'npm test && git diff --check && git diff -- lib/dates.js reports/summary.js'

item.text:
Fixed both issues:

- Corrected zero-based JavaScript month formatting.
- Renamed the report title to **“Resumen diario”**.

`npm test` now passes: **2/2 tests**.
